title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Psalms 33: a new song to Yahweh, the heavens made by his word, and his eye on those who fear him.

questions.text: In verse 2, which instrument is mentioned alongside the lyre for praising Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to give thanks with the lyre and to sing praises with the harp of ten strings.

questions.text: What kind of song does verse 3 call for?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says, "Sing to him a new song."

questions.text: According to verse 6, by what were the heavens made?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that by Yahweh's word the heavens were made.

questions.text: What does Yahweh do with the waters of the sea in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap.

answers.text: He pours them over the mountains
He gathers them together as a heap

questions.text: What does Yahweh do with the counsel of the nations?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing.

answers.text: He writes it in a book

questions.text: Which nation does verse 12 call blessed?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh."

answers.text: The nation whose God is Yahweh
The nation with the largest army
The nation with the most gold
The nation that lives by the sea

questions.text: What does verse 17 call a vain thing for safety?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says a horse is a vain thing for safety.

questions.text: On whom is Yahweh's eye, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says Yahweh's eye is on those who fear him and hope in his loving kindness.

questions.text: In verse 19, where does Yahweh keep those who fear him alive?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says he delivers their soul from death and keeps them alive in famine.

questions.text: Verse 20 says Yahweh is "our help and our..." what?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says, "He is our help and our shield."
